notes.text: I just started my review with the new privacy and trust hero. None feel right. I think the density needs to increase as well as the speed. Also, when I said decaying trail, I meant of the trailing images, not an actual separate trail effect.

answers.note: Question is clear, but I don't really like this arrival animation as part of the spiral/orbit.

This feels super bespoke to 'privacy', where it's only revealing what it wants to. Really cool concept. Would love to keep this original plus 3 variations to nail it. The sweep could be banked as something generic if we get desperate, or as a foundation for another hero. I think the aperture (with more polish) could be a super cool minimalist CTA section card background. Don't like the sealed cards at all.
